headline: Claude Opus 5 hits all-time high; Google surges 3.2 points
summary: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 just set its second consecutive all-time token-share record at 7.6%, while Google jumped 3.2 percentage points in a single day—its biggest daily gain in the dataset. DeepSeek still dominates at 25.7% but lost ground to both Anthropic (now 10.5%) and Google (9.9%), which are closing in fast. Three new models entered the rankings, and three others dropped out.
highlights: Claude Opus 5 (Anthropic) reaches 7.6% token share—day 2 of its all-time high streak
Google gains 3.2 points in one day, now at 9.9% provider share (up 4.3% over 7 days)
DeepSeek's flash variant still #1 at 14.0%, but the provider shed 0.8 points daily
Tencent's HY3 drops 1.4 points in 24 hours, down 7.0% over the week
OpenAI's gpt-5.5 and gpt-oss-20b debut; Qwen's qwen3.7-max and Nex AGI's nex-n2-mini exit
